description: Unified SVG diagram canvas (draw.io‑inspired 4‑pane architecture: backgroundPane / drawPane / overlayPane / decoratorPane). Renders DiagramDocument nodes and edges as native SVG primitives and foreignObject labels, and communicates with diagram-editor.js for pan, zoom, drag, and selection.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document to display and edit.

parameters.name: ActiveGroupId
parameters.description: Active group identifier. Only nodes with matching ParentGroupId are rendered.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the canvas wrapper.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised after every mutation.

parameters.name: GridSize
parameters.description: Snap-to-grid cell size in pixels. 0 = disabled.

parameters.name: OnCanvasContextMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(double CanvasX, double CanvasY, double ScreenX, double ScreenY)>
parameters.description: Raised when the empty canvas is right-clicked to open a context menu.

parameters.name: OnClearTableCellSelection
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Escape and there is a table cell sub-selection that should be cleared before the node selection. Used to implement the draw.io-style "drill-out" cascade (first Escape exits cell mode, second Escape clears node selection).

parameters.name: OnCloseContextMenu
parameters.description: Raised when the context menu should be closed (e.g. second right-click).

parameters.name: OnEdgeContextMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string EdgeId, double ScreenX, double ScreenY)>
parameters.description: Raised when an edge is right-clicked to open a context menu.

parameters.name: ShowPageView
parameters.description: Show page view with shadow and boundaries.

parameters.name: OnConnectArrowClicked
parameters.description: Raised when a connect arrow is clicked.

parameters.name: OnToolboxDrop
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string StencilId, double X, double Y)>

parameters.name: OnEdgeCreated
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string? SourceNodeId, string? SourcePortId, string? TargetNodeId, string? TargetPortId, string? SourceSide, double SourceOffset, string? TargetSide, double TargetOffset, string? TargetEdgeId, double TargetEdgeT, double? SourceConstraintRx, double? SourceConstraintRy, bool? SourceConstraintPerimeter, double? TargetConstraintRx, double? TargetConstraintRy, bool? TargetConstraintPerimeter, double? TargetPointX, double? TargetPointY, double? SourcePointX, double? SourcePointY, double[]? WaypointsXY)>

parameters.name: OnEnterGroup
parameters.description: Raised when the user double-clicks or presses Ctrl+Shift+G on a group to enter it.

parameters.name: OnExitGroup
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+Shift+F to exit the current group.

parameters.name: OnGroupSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+Shift+G to group selected nodes.

parameters.name: OnLockSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+Shift+L to lock selected nodes.

parameters.name: OnNavigateToCorner
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+Home/End to navigate to a corner.

parameters.name: OnNodeContextMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string NodeId, double ScreenX, double ScreenY)>
parameters.description: Raised when a node is right-clicked or long-pressed to open a context menu.

parameters.name: OnNodeLinkClicked
parameters.description: Raised when a node with a link is clicked.

parameters.name: OnPortMouseDown
parameters.description: Raised when a port is clicked to start drawing an edge.

parameters.name: OnQuickInsert
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses a quick-insert stencil key (A,S,D,F,R).

parameters.name: OnRedo
parameters.description: Raised when user requests redo.

parameters.name: OnRulerCursorMoved
parameters.description: Raised when the ruler cursor moves.

parameters.name: OnSelectionChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user changes the selection.

parameters.name: OnShowReplace
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+F.

parameters.name: OnShowSearch
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+F.

parameters.name: OnSwitchPage
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown to switch page.

parameters.name: OnTableCellContextMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string NodeId, int Row, int Column, double ScreenX, double ScreenY)>
parameters.description: Raised when a table cell is right-clicked to open a context menu.

parameters.name: OnTableCellSelect
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string NodeId, int Row, int Column, bool IsCtrlHeld)>
parameters.description: Raised when a table cell is clicked (with or without Ctrl).

parameters.name: OnToggleBold
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+B to toggle bold on selected nodes.

parameters.name: OnToggleItalic
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+I to toggle italic on selected nodes.

parameters.name: OnToggleUnderline
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses Ctrl+U to toggle underline on selected nodes.

parameters.name: OnToolModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user switches tool mode.

parameters.name: OnUndo
parameters.description: Raised when user requests undo.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Prevent all editing interactions.

parameters.name: SelectedTableCells
parameters.description: Selected table cells for multi-select merge UI.

parameters.name: ShowGrid
parameters.description: Show grid lines on the canvas background.

parameters.name: ViewportChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the viewport changes after pan, zoom, or fit.

parameters.name: Zoom
parameters.description: Current zoom level used for pixel-to-document conversion.

parameters.name: ZoomChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the zoom level changes (e.g. via wheel).
